# Paths whose EncinaErrors.Create / FromException calls do not declare an ErrorCategory yet (ADR-062, #3419).
# Read by ErrorCategoryCompletenessStaticScanTests. Format: "<path prefix relative to the repo root> => <owner>",
# where the owner is the migration slice (P-<package>, C1-C5, M1, M2, EF1, EF2, H1-H3) or the owning issue.
# One entry per line and a blank line between entries, so parallel slices that delete their own line merge
# without conflict. A slice that categorizes every call under its prefix deletes its line; the scan fails on a
# stale line. Generated by running the scan once over src/ at the start of the migration (#3545).
# Codes that #3420 owns stay uncategorized after their package's slice; that slice narrows its line to them.
